en: the best thing of all, I'd say.
note: Finishes #5359 (slice 066), which ends with '... a pleasant morning is'.

en: Some people have no chance to enjoy that,
forced as they are to live such poor, hard
lives, after all.
It's best to rise early in the morning.
It feels different from the day or night.
And how are you feeling today?
Do keep well, won't you?
Running into you this early in the morning...
I feel there's some bond between us.
Let's both work hard today. Good day, then.
Good evening, sir.
Might I have a moment?
What is it?
My name is Bruce.
I'm a director of the London Charity Society.
Pardon my asking, but do you have a job?
I see. My apologies, then.
Few young people join our charity work,
so lately I've been going around asking
people like this.
Oh, I must hurry. If you'll excuse me.
Forgive me, I'm in a hurry.
Good evening. Good to see you again.
Hmm, I see.
note: Flag 4 = the player said he is weak in the mornings (#5357).

en: You do seem livelier at night.
Do take good care of your health. Farewell.
Please don't mind what happened last time.
note: Flag 5 = Bruce asked whether the player had a job (msg 221992).

en: Well then, good evening to you.
By the way... what line of work are you in?
<Something like a detective>
Oh, do forgive me.
It seems I shouldn't have asked.
I meant no offense. Please pardon me.
Ah, I thought as much.
I'd heard talk that you were making inquiries
around town, so I wondered.
Welcome to the London Charity Society.
Have you come to offer to volunteer,
or some other kind of help?
No,
I was curious what goes on here, so I
just dropped by... Sorry to intrude.
No, no, not at all.
As I said, this is the Charity Society's
headquarters.
I'm Bruce, the director. A pleasure.
I moved to London recently.
I see. No wonder you lost your way.
Think nothing of it. If you'd like to help
the less fortunate, please do come again.
Oh? Why, you're the one from before...
I was curious what you do here, so I
just dropped by.
Allow me to introduce myself properly.
Please, have a seat.
If you have time, do stay and talk.
Few people offer to help, you know.
I suppose they have their hands full living.
Councillor Norman seems busy as well,
so we rarely get to meet and discuss things.
I'm glad to see you looking well.
It's quiet here, isn't it?
I set out eager to devote half my life
to charity, but hardly anyone really
understands...
Hello. How are you?
I intend to keep up my charity work.
I won't give up my ideals.
I was born into a noble family,
and grew up arrogant...
thinking that was only natural.
But when I learned of lives unlike mine,
I realized there might be something more
precious than tradition or lineage.
That feeling hasn't changed, even now.
You listened to me so patiently.
note: Followed by #2522 'Thank you very much.' (own sentence), so this row is a full sentence.

en: Yes. What can I do for you?
I don't believe I've seen you before...
